Playlist.title: Playlist
Playlist.description: A user-created local music playlist synced to the cloud.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the playlist owner.

createdAtMs.description: Client creation epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

updatedAtMs.description: Client last modification epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on writes.

PlaylistTrack.title: PlaylistTrack
PlaylistTrack.description: An ordered song entry inside a user playlist.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

songKey.description: Deterministic song identifier derived from title, artist, and duration.

position.description: Zero-based custom sort index inside the playlist.

addedAtMs.description: Epoch timestamp when the track was added.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on writes.

SongStat.title: SongStat
SongStat.description: Listening statistics for a single song.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

songKey.description: Deterministic song identifier matching document ID.

playCount.description: Total number of times the song was played.

listenedMs.description: Total accumulated listening time in milliseconds for this song.

lastPlayedAtMs.description: Last played epoch timestamp in milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on writes.

ListeningSummary.title: ListeningSummary
ListeningSummary.description: Aggregate listening statistics summary for a user.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the owner.

totalListeningMs.description: Total accumulated listening duration in milliseconds.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on writes.

/users/{userId}/playlists/{playlistId}/t.description: Ordered tracks belonging to a user playlist.

/users/{userId}/songStats/{songKey}.description: Per-song play count and listening time statistics.
